Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the Wikipedia content by incorrectly aligning the grandparent pairs and confusing paternal and maternal lines, concluding that Concepción Sáenz de Tejada (the paternal grandmother) was the maternal grandmother. This contradicted the explicit statement that he is the maternal-line grandson of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sofía, and ignored earlier correct understanding.
